note: The UN country team's UPR submission names no civil registration information system. It states that the civil status modernisation policy (the Politique nationale de réforme et de modernisation de l'état civil 2021-2025) was adopted in 2022 and not yet implemented, including interoperability with the health system; that late registration needs a prosecutor's requisition or a court's authorisation and can cost up to 30,000 FCFA; and that 125 civil status agents of Cuvette department were trained in 2022. It does not say how offices make the record.
